message: No detected input validation: The code reads edge, label, and feature files directly without any schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards; it just splits tokens and uses them as-is.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from local file paths configured via config.ini; there is no remote fetch, checksum verification, or authentication of any data source.
No detected label flipping detection: The code loads labels from a file but performs no validation of label values, distribution checks, or noise detection before training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: The data preparation code reads edges and nodes from files without any outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs.

No detected model integrity verification: No hash checks, signature verification, or pinned revision controls are present when loading pretrained weights or serialized models; the code reads config paths and loads data/models without any integrity validation.
No detected label distribution validation: There is no code that checks class balance, validates label distributions, or detects anomalous training samples before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: No backdoor defenses such as neural cleanse, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection are present anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: There is no use of Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, or any other differential privacy mechanism in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries or attack methods (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) are imported or invoked anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of a held-out test set isolation mechanism, signed/hashed evaluation data, or use of multiple independent metrics to protect against metric manipulation.
No detected input sanitization: The code reads raw files and command-line arguments without any shape, range, type, or schema validation before passing data to models.
No detected output bounds checks: No checks on model outputs such as NaN guards, probability bounds, or threshold validation are present in the visible code.
No detected prompt injection defenses: The pipeline uses graph embedding models (RHINE, Metapath2vec, HAN, etc.), not LLMs, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and not implemented.
